Subject: Revisions to the Academic Integrity Policy

Dear students,

Following consultation with faculty and the Student Union, the University Senate has approved revisions to the Academic Integrity Policy, effective at the start of the spring term. The most significant change concerns the use of generative AI tools. Rather than imposing a university-wide ban, the revised policy delegates authority to individual instructors, who must specify in their syllabi whether, and to what extent, such tools may be used. Where a syllabus is silent, the use of these tools in assessed work will be presumed to be unauthorized. Students who are uncertain are strongly encouraged to seek clarification before submitting work.

Office of the Provost
